display_name: Awareness E13: The AI assistant (full episode)
description: An awareness episode of about 15 minutes for all staff. On an authorised exercise at Brightwell Foods, a fictional company, you first play the red team: write a supplier brief with a line hidden in it for the firm's new assistant. Then you use the assistant for real and handle a supplier email, a voicemail and a video call. Only the second part is scored, and checking another way when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
